summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 diffusion language model 推理中的 block completion barrier。现有 block-wise semi-autoregressive decoding 通常要求当前 block 完成或耗尽 denoising budget 后，下一 block 才能开始。问题在于，当前 block 里剩余的低置信 token 还在 refinement 时，后续生成有时已经可以依赖一个稳定前缀或 delimiter boundary 继续推进。把 refinement 和 advancement 绑在同一条串行路径上，会浪费推理并行性。
summary.importance: 它对预训练方向的直接贡献有限，主要是 diffusion LM 的 decoding 和 serving 调度。但它提供了一个有用信号：非 AR 模型的吞吐优势不只来自一次预测多个 mask token，也取决于推理依赖图能否被重新组织。对于设计 diffusion/any-order LM 的训练目标，这篇论文也提醒一点：如果模型能更早形成可靠边界或稳定语义前缀，推理调度就有更多空间。因此它更像是连接建模范式和系统效率的工作。
summary.technical_approach: AsyncLane 是 training-free scheduler，不改模型参数。它把标准 block-wise decoding 中的单一全局 block pointer 替换为 active lanes。generate lane 负责推进生成前沿；refine lane 负责继续修正已经发现的前缀。当 generate lane 暴露出可靠 delimiter boundary 时，调度器执行 branch-and-refine：边界前的前缀交给 refine lane，边界后的 continuation 交给新的 generate lane。这样，未来区域可以开始 denoising，而过去前缀仍保持可编辑。为了降低多 lane 带来的模型调用开销，论文利用 fork 后 sibling lanes 共享前缀状态，做 grouped batched forwards；复用 future-window logits 作为后续 generate lane 的高置信 draft；用 cascading termination 避免在 EOS 或未解决前沿之后继续创建无效 lane；并通过 compact cache refresh 和 refresh-logit reuse 控制双向 attention 下的 stale prefix 问题。
summary.experiments: 实验在 LLaDA 和 Dream 两类 diffusion LM backbone 上进行，任务包括 mathematical reasoning 和 code generation。论文报告 AsyncLane 在所有测试的 benchmark-length 设置下取得最高 throughput，并且生成长度越长，吞吐优势越明显。质量方面保持 competitive generation quality，没有把速度收益完全建立在明显退化的输出上。给出的全文片段没有包含具体吞吐数字、pass 数、延迟或准确率表，因此只能确认趋势和比较结论，不能核验精确幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20-30 分钟。重点看方法图和 active-lane scheduling 的定义，理解 lane state、generate/refine role、boundary-triggered fork 的执行顺序。然后看 efficient execution 部分，尤其是 grouped batched forwards、future-window logit reuse、cache refresh 这几项，因为这些决定了多 lane 调度是否真的省时。实验部分主要看按生成长度分组的 throughput-quality 曲线，以及 LLaDA 与 Dream 上是否表现一致。若关注预训练本身，可以快速读完，不必深挖系统实现细节；若在做 diffusion LM serving，则值得仔细检查边界检测规则和 stale prefix 处理。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the block completion barrier in diffusion language model decoding. In common block-wise semi-autoregressive decoding, the next block cannot start until the current block is fully decoded or its denoising budget is exhausted. This serializes two different operations: refining low-confidence positions in the current block and advancing the generation frontier. Once a stable prefix or delimiter boundary has emerged, the continuation does not always need to wait for every remaining token in the current block to be resolved.
summary_en.importance: The direct relevance to pretraining is moderate; this is primarily a decoding and serving scheduler for diffusion LMs. Its broader lesson is useful: the throughput advantage of non-AR models depends not only on predicting multiple masked tokens per pass, but also on how the inference dependency graph is scheduled. It also gives a modeling signal. If a diffusion or any-order LM can expose reliable boundaries early, decoding can exploit more parallelism. The work therefore sits between modeling assumptions and systems efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: AsyncLane is a training-free scheduler. It replaces the single global block pointer in standard block-wise decoding with a set of active lanes. A generate lane advances the frontier. A refine lane keeps improving an already discovered prefix. When a generate lane reveals a reliable delimiter boundary, the scheduler performs branch-and-refine: the prefix before the boundary is assigned to a refine lane, and the continuation after the boundary is assigned to a new generate lane. The future region can then begin denoising while the past remains editable. To keep the cost under control, AsyncLane exploits shared prefix states among forked sibling lanes and evaluates them with grouped batched forwards. It reuses future-window logits as high-confidence drafts for later generate lanes, uses cascading termination to avoid creating lanes beyond EOS or unresolved frontiers, and applies compact cache refresh plus refresh-logit reuse to reduce stale-prefix issues under bidirectional attention.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are reported on LLaDA and Dream backbones, with mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks. AsyncLane achieves the highest throughput across the evaluated benchmark-length settings, and the advantage becomes larger for longer generations. Generation quality remains competitive, so the speedup is not simply obtained by allowing large quality degradation. The provided full-content excerpt does not include exact throughput, latency, pass-count, or accuracy numbers, so the quantitative magnitude cannot be independently summarized beyond the reported trend.
summary_en.reading_guide: A practical skim takes about 20-30 minutes. Focus first on the method figure and the definition of active-lane scheduling: lane state, generate versus refine roles, and the boundary-triggered fork procedure. Then read the efficient execution part, especially grouped batched forwards, future-window logit reuse, and cache refresh, because these details determine whether multiple active lanes reduce wall-clock time. In the experiments, look for throughput-quality curves grouped by generation length and check whether the behavior is consistent on both LLaDA and Dream. For pretraining-focused readers, a quick read is enough. For diffusion LM serving work, the boundary detection rule and stale-prefix handling are the parts to inspect carefully.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该看，尤其如果你还在判断 DLM 有没有工程生命力；先看调度假设和 wall-clock 表，若收益真实，很多“DLM 太慢”的 prior 要改写一部分。
recommendation.en: This is worth reading if you still doubt DLMs have any systems future; check the scheduling assumptions and wall-clock tables first—if the gains are real, part of the “DLMs are too slow” prior needs updating.

paper.title: Fast-dLLM++: Fréchet Profile Decoding for Faster Diffusion LLM Inference

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 diffusion LLM 推理里的一个很具体但关键的问题：在并行解码时，哪些 masked 位置可以在同一步里一起“提交”而不明显伤害质量。Fast-dLLM 已经给出过基于置信度的并行提交规则，但它把候选集合压缩成“最弱那个 token 的置信度”来做决策，相当于用最坏情况代表整个集合。论文指出这在真实解码里过于保守，因为不同位置的置信度往往高度异质：少数位置几乎确定，少数位置只是中等确定。如果仍按 weakest-token 规则裁剪，就会白白损失可并行性，导致 diffusion LM 理论上的并行优势在实际推理里兑现不足。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，它不是训练范式创新，而是 diffusion LM 走向可用推理路径上的一块基础拼图。价值主要有三层。第一，它把“并行提交”从经验启发式推进到更严格的分布无关证书，说明在只知道边缘置信度、不了解位置间依赖结构时，还能做到多保守、多激进。第二，它直接服务于 diffusion/MDLM 这条非 AR 语言建模路线的现实瓶颈：如果推理速度始终被保守提交规则卡住，再好的训练目标也很难形成系统优势。第三，它给出一个很清楚的结论：异质置信度不是噪声，而是可利用的结构信号。这个判断对后续做 profile-aware decoding、学习式提交策略、甚至训练时显式塑造置信度分布，都有启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法是 training-free 的，对已有 diffusion LLM 直接替换提交规则。核心做法叫 Fréchet profile decoding。设当前一步有若干 masked 位置，每个位置都有模型给出的 greedy token 及其边缘置信度。Fast-dLLM 的 factor rule 只看 top-n 候选里最小的那个置信度 c(n)，接受条件形如 (n+1)(1-c(n)) < f，本质是把所有已选 token 当成同一置信度处理。Fast-dLLM++ 则保留完整排序后的置信度 profile (c(1), c(2), ..., c(n))，对每个前缀大小 n 计算两个量：一是所有 n 个 greedy token 同时正确的联合概率下界 Ln；二是任意竞争 tuple 的概率上界 Un。若 Ln - Un > δ，就认为这个前缀足够安全，可以整体提交，并选择满足条件的最大前缀。

这里的关键不是换了一个经验分数，而是用了 Fréchet 型界来构造“只依赖边缘概率、对依赖关系最坏情况仍成立”的保守证书。论文证明了：在没有额外位置依赖信息时，这类 Fréchet 下界已经是 distribution-free 场景下最强的保守证书之一；也就是说，只靠边缘置信度，理论上很难再做得更强。另一个重要点是它和旧规则的关系。作者证明在 equal-confidence 特例下，新规则会退化回 Fast-dLLM 的 factor decoding，因此它不是另起炉灶，而是对 homogeneous-confidence 假设的严格推广。

论文还给出 heterogeneity bonus 分解，解释为什么 profile-aware 规则能多提交 token：当 profile 前部有一批极高置信度位置时，联合正确事件的下界不会像 weakest-token 近似那样被末尾中等置信度位置完全拖垮，因此可接受前缀会更长。工程上它兼容 KV cache 和不同 cache regime，不需要额外 verifier 或 drafter，这一点和 AR 里的 speculative decoding 路线不同。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖文本推理、代码和多模态推理，模型包括 LLaDA-8B-Instruct、Dream-v0-Base-7B，以及多模态版本 LLaDA-V；任务包括 GSM8K、MATH、HumanEval、MBPP。论文主结果不是单点精度，而是 accuracy-throughput frontier：在相同质量下获得更高吞吐，或在相同吞吐下保持更好准确率。按照文中描述，Fast-dLLM++ 在多种 generation length 和 cache 设置下都优于原始 Fast-dLLM 的 threshold/factor 规则，收益在置信度分布更异质、生成更长、并行空间更大的场景更明显。

消融的重点有三类。第一，equal-confidence 与 heterogeneous-confidence 对比，验证理论上新规则在同质情形退化为旧规则，而在异质情形出现额外并行收益。第二，margin 参数 δ、不同 cache regime、不同 commit size 的敏感性分析，用来展示速度和质量之间的可调边界。第三，多任务与多模型泛化，说明收益不是某个特定 diffusion LM 或某个 benchmark 的偶然现象。给出的全文片段里没有完整表格数字，因此不适合编造具体提升百分比；但从实验组织看，作者是在用“前沿曲线整体右移”而不是单个点胜负来论证方法有效，这对解码论文是更合理的证据形式。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓三处。第一，看 Introduction 和方法总览图，明确它到底替换了 Fast-dLLM 的哪一部分，以及为什么 weakest-token 假设会保守。第二，看理论部分里关于 Theorem 4.1 和 strongest distribution-free certificate 的论证，这决定了方法不是拍脑袋调规则，而是在“只知道边缘置信度”这个信息约束下尽量做满。第三，看 heterogeneity-bonus decomposition 和主实验的 frontier 图，理解收益来自哪里，而不是只记住“更快”。

如果时间有限，建议阅读顺序是：Introduction → 提交规则定义 → equal-confidence 退化关系 → 主实验图。预计 25–35 分钟可以把主要思想读清。若想深挖，重点看 Fréchet 下界如何构造、Un 如何定义，以及这些界在真实模型校准误差存在时是否仍稳健。这也是后续研究最值得追问的地方：当前证书只利用边缘置信度，若能引入轻量依赖估计，是否还能继续放宽提交条件。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a central inference bottleneck in diffusion LLMs: deciding which masked positions can be committed in parallel at each denoising step without hurting generation quality too much. Fast-dLLM already introduced confidence-guided commit rules, but its theory collapses a candidate set to the weakest selected token. That is a worst-case homogeneous-confidence approximation. The authors argue this is unnecessarily conservative because real confidence profiles are highly heterogeneous: a few positions are near-certain while others are only moderately confident. If the whole set is judged by the weakest token, useful parallelism is left unused.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining recipe paper, but it matters for the viability of diffusion-style language modeling as a competing paradigm to autoregressive decoding. Its contribution is mainly on the inference side, yet the implication is broader: if diffusion LMs cannot cash out their parallel-generation advantage at decode time, architectural or objective-level gains will not translate into system-level wins. The paper also makes a more general point that confidence heterogeneity is exploitable structure rather than nuisance. That idea could later feed back into training, calibration, or learned commit policies.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Fast-dLLM++ is a training-free replacement for the commit rule used during diffusion decoding. Instead of using only the weakest confidence among the top-n candidate positions, it keeps the full sorted confidence profile (c(1), c(2), ..., c(n)). For each candidate prefix of size n, it computes a Fréchet lower bound L_n on the probability that all n marginal greedy tokens are jointly correct, and an upper bound U_n on the probability of any competing tuple. The decoder commits the largest prefix satisfying L_n - U_n > delta, where delta is a safety margin.

The key technical move is that the certificate is built from marginal confidences only, with no explicit dependence model across positions. The paper proves that this yields a heterogeneous-confidence sufficient condition under which greedy parallel decoding matches the true joint greedy decision. It further argues that, without additional dependence information, the Fréchet-based certificate is the strongest conservative distribution-free guarantee available from marginals alone. This is the main theoretical claim.

Another useful result is the reduction to the previous rule: in the equal-confidence case, the new criterion collapses exactly to Fast-dLLM factor decoding. So the method is not a disconnected heuristic; it is a strict generalization of the homogeneous-confidence analysis. The heterogeneity-bonus decomposition then explains when gains appear: if the confidence profile has a strong head and a weaker tail, the full-profile certificate can still justify committing a larger set, whereas the weakest-token rule gets dominated by the tail. Operationally, the method remains compatible with KV caching and does not require a separate drafter or verifier, unlike speculative decoding for AR models.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation spans reasoning, math, code, and multimodal reasoning. Models include LLaDA-8B-Instruct, Dream-v0-Base-7B, and LLaDA-V. Benchmarks include GSM8K, MATH, HumanEval, and MBPP. The main empirical claim is not a single-point accuracy gain but a better accuracy-throughput frontier: at matched quality, Fast-dLLM++ achieves higher throughput; at matched throughput, it preserves better accuracy than prior threshold/factor rules.

The ablations are structured around the theory. First, the paper contrasts homogeneous and heterogeneous confidence settings, showing that the new rule reduces to the old one in the equal-confidence regime and gains only when profile heterogeneity exists. Second, it studies the effect of the margin parameter, cache regimes, and generation length, which clarifies the speed-quality trade-off. Third, it tests multiple models and tasks to argue the effect is not benchmark-specific. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the final numeric tables, so it is better not to invent exact deltas. Still, the experimental design is appropriate for a decoding paper because it focuses on frontier shifts rather than isolated wins.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and the main method figure to understand exactly what part of Fast-dLLM is being replaced and why the weakest-token abstraction is too conservative. Second, read the theorem establishing the sufficient condition and the claim about the strongest distribution-free certificate. That is the difference between a principled decoding rule and another heuristic. Third, inspect the heterogeneity-bonus analysis and the main frontier plots to see where the practical gains come from.

A good reading order is: Introduction -> commit rule definition -> reduction to the equal-confidence case -> main experimental figures. Around 25 to 35 minutes should be enough for the main idea. If reading more deeply, pay attention to how L_n and U_n are constructed and ask how robust the certificate is under calibration error in model confidences. That is likely the most important follow-up question.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在跟踪 AR 之外的 LM 范式，这篇该看；先盯速度-质量折中表，若只省步数不省 wall-clock，就别高估它。
recommendation.en: If you track non-AR LM paradigms, this is worth a look; focus on the speed-quality tradeoff table first—if it cuts steps but not wall-clock, do not overrate it.

paper.title: Decoding in Order-Agnostic Language Models: Chain-Rule Deviation and Uniform Spreading
paper.abstract: Order-agnostic language models (OALMs), including discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs), are trained to predict masked tokens under arbitrary conditioning sets, allowing sequences to be generated or scored under arbitrary reveal orders at inference time. In LLaDA-2.1, we report three findings. First, the learned conditionals are not exact factorizations of a coherent joint distribution: changing only the reveal order shifts target log-likelihood by up to 0.49 nats/token, so likelihood alone

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是 order-agnostic language model，尤其是离散 diffusion LM，在“可以按任意顺序揭示 token”这一能力下，解码顺序到底意味着什么。作者抓住了两个核心问题。第一，这类模型学到的条件分布未必来自同一个一致的联合分布，因此同一目标序列仅仅改变 reveal order，累计 log-likelihood 就会变化，链式分解不再路径无关。第二，即便总概率相近，不同顺序把“置信度预算”分配到各步的方式不同，而 greedy decoding 的成败往往由最薄弱的一步决定。于是，只看总 logP 不够，还要看每一步置信度是否均匀展开。
summary.importance: 对新型语言建模范式的价值很直接。很多人把 any-order / diffusion LM 的推断顺序当成一个工程层面的 decoding trick，但这篇文章说明，顺序本身暴露了模型训练目标的内在不一致性，也决定了生成可靠性的另一条轴。对预训练研究来说，这有两层启发。其一，若一个 OALM 的条件分布不满足 chain-rule consistency，那么用不同 reveal order 做打分、重排、偏好比较时，数值本身已经混入路径伪影，不能直接当作“同一 joint 的不同分解”。其二，训练目标若只鼓励局部条件预测，却不约束不同路径之间的一致性，推断时就会出现预算分配不均，导致某些顺序更容易在局部 argmax 上失手。这个问题和 diffusion LM、masked LM、any-order AR 都相关，属于建模范式层面的诊断，而不是某个 benchmark 上的小技巧。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上分成经验诊断和一个小理论结果。经验部分，作者在 LLaDA-2.1-mini 上固定模型与目标序列，只改变 reveal order，比较路径上的逐步条件概率 q_t(π)=pθ(x*_{π(t)}|R_{t-1},c)。如果这些条件分布真来自同一个联合分布，那么按 chain rule，∑t log q_t 应该与顺序无关。作者发现并非如此，说明模型不是一个严格一致的 joint estimator。

理论部分提出了 uniform-spreading theorem。作者把目标序列恢复看成一串局部 argmax 决策：每一步不仅要让正确 token 概率高，还要高过局部竞争者。若固定总预算 P=∏t q_t，那么最有利的情况不是把高置信度集中在少数步，而是让每一步都尽量均匀，即 q_t=P^{1/n}。偏离这种均匀分布的结构性代价可以由 Var(log q_t) 描述。于是，logP 衡量总预算，Var(log q_t) 衡量预算分配是否平滑，二者构成互补诊断轴。

在解码策略分析上，作者比较了 Forced-AR、Random、以及 confidence-first 的 Max-prob 和 Top-margin。一个有意思的发现是，CF 虽然名义上是 order-agnostic，但在内容 token 上走出的 reveal path 与严格 left-to-right 很接近；它的主要偏离出现在短答案场景，会触发 tail-EOS cascade。这解释了为什么一些看似“非 AR”的顺序策略，实际行为却接近 AR。
summary.experiments:
关键实验集中在 LLaDA-2.1-mini 和 C4 片段上。作者从 1,000 个随机 C4 样本中切出 prefix 和 target continuation，固定目标序列后比较不同 reveal order 的路径分数。结果显示，仅改变顺序，logP/n 最多可偏移 0.49 nats/token。这个量级已经远超可以忽略的数值误差，足以说明 learned conditionals 不是同一个 joint 的精确分解。

在生成层面，作者比较多种 one-token-per-step 策略。Structured 策略——Forced-AR、Max-prob、Top-margin——在外部 perplexity 上相近，但 Var(log q_t) 明显低于 Random。作者进一步做 reveal-order analysis，发现 Max-prob 和 Top-margin 的非 EOS 内容路径与 L2R 高度接近，因此它们表现相似并不奇怪；差异主要来自短答案任务中 CF 更容易提前形成 EOS 尾部连锁。

下游验证覆盖 HellaSwag、CMath、MMLU-Pro、IFEval。论文的重点不是刷新绝对分数，而是看 correctness 与方差轴的关系。结论是：较低的 Var(log q_t) 与正确生成稳定相关，而且这种相关性不能简单归因于 Random 整体太差，因为在多种策略和样本层面都能看到同样趋势。换句话说，confidence trace 的平滑程度确实携带了生成可靠性信息。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议先看三部分。第一是引言前半段，作者把 OALM、dLLM、reveal order、路径分数的定义讲得比较清楚。第二是 §4.2，那里给出最关键的 chain-rule deviation 结果：同一目标序列换顺序后 logP/n 可漂移约 0.5 nats/token。第三是 Theorem 3.1 及其解释，不必逐行推导，但要理解为什么 greedy decoding 更怕单步瓶颈，因此 Var(log q_t) 会成为有意义的诊断量。

如果只有 20 分钟，建议读法是：Introduction → Theorem 3.1 的结论和图示 → §4.2 的固定序列打分实验 → §4.3 的 reveal-order analysis → §4.4 的 benchmark 相关性结果。阅读时要注意作者并没有证明“低方差一定带来更高任务分数”，而是提出一个比总 logP 更贴近解码可靠性的补充指标。值得继续深挖的点包括：训练时能否显式加入 path consistency 约束；以及在更大规模 dLLM 上，这种 0.49 nats/token 的路径漂移会缩小还是放大。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks what decoding order really means in order-agnostic language models, especially discrete diffusion LMs that can reveal tokens in arbitrary orders. It isolates two issues. First, the learned conditionals need not correspond to a single coherent joint distribution, so the cumulative log-likelihood of the same target sequence can change when only the reveal order changes. Second, even when total probability is similar, decoding reliability depends on how confidence is distributed across steps, because greedy generation can fail at a single weak step. So total logP is not enough; one also needs to inspect the shape of the confidence trace.
summary_en.importance: This matters directly for alternative language-modeling paradigms. Reveal order in diffusion or any-order LMs is often treated as a decoding choice, but the paper shows that it also exposes a modeling inconsistency inherited from training. For pretraining research, there are two concrete implications. First, if an OALM violates chain-rule consistency, then likelihood comparisons across reveal orders are contaminated by path artifacts and should not be interpreted as different factorizations of the same joint. Second, if training only teaches local conditional prediction without enforcing cross-path consistency, inference can allocate confidence unevenly across steps, making some orders much more brittle under greedy decoding. That is a modeling issue, not just a decoding heuristic issue.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper combines an empirical diagnostic with a compact theoretical result. Empirically, it fixes the model and target sequence in LLaDA-2.1-mini, varies only the reveal order, and evaluates the pathwise conditional probabilities q_t(π)=pθ(x*_{π(t)}|R_{t-1},c). If these conditionals came from a coherent joint distribution, the chain rule would make the sum of log q_t invariant to order. The paper shows that this invariance fails in practice.

The theoretical contribution is the uniform-spreading theorem. The authors frame target recovery as a sequence of local argmax decisions. At each step, success depends not only on the target probability q_t itself, but on whether it wins against local competitors. Holding the total budget P=∏t q_t fixed, recoverability is uniquely maximized when confidence is spread uniformly across steps, q_t=P^(1/n). The structural penalty for uneven allocation is captured by Var(log q_t). This yields two complementary diagnostics: logP measures total confidence budget, while Var(log q_t) measures how efficiently a reveal order distributes that budget.

The paper then analyzes several decoding strategies: Forced-AR, Random, and confidence-first variants such as Max-prob and Top-margin. A notable empirical finding is that confidence-first decoding, although order-agnostic in principle, follows reveal paths that are close to left-to-right on content tokens. Its main deviation appears in short-answer settings, where it can trigger a tail-EOS cascade.
summary_en.experiments:
The main experiments use LLaDA-2.1-mini on fixed target continuations from C4. The authors sample 1,000 random C4 examples, split each into a prefix and target continuation, and compare path scores under different reveal orders. The headline result is that changing only the order can shift logP/n by as much as 0.49 nats per token. That is far beyond numerical noise and is strong evidence that the learned conditionals are not exact factorizations of one coherent joint distribution.

For generation behavior, the paper compares one-token-per-step strategies. Structured strategies—Forced-AR, Max-prob, and Top-margin—show similar external perplexity, but substantially lower Var(log q_t) than Random. Reveal-order analysis explains why: Max-prob and Top-margin traverse content-token paths that are very close to strict left-to-right decoding, so their behavior is much less exotic than the order-agnostic label suggests. The main difference comes from short-answer prompts, where confidence-first rules can exploit a tail-EOS cascade.

Downstream validation covers HellaSwag, CMath, MMLU-Pro, and IFEval. The point is not headline benchmark gains, but the relationship between correctness and the variance axis. Lower Var(log q_t) is consistently associated with correct generations, and the pattern is not reducible to Random simply being weak overall. That supports the claim that confidence-trace smoothness carries information about decoding reliability beyond total path likelihood.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, focus on three parts. First, the early introduction, which clearly defines OALMs, dLLMs, reveal order, and pathwise scoring. Second, §4.2, which contains the most important empirical result: logP/n for the same target can drift by about 0.5 nats/token across reveal orders. Third, Theorem 3.1 and its interpretation. You do not need every derivation detail, but you should understand why greedy decoding is vulnerable to a single low-confidence bottleneck, which makes Var(log q_t) a meaningful diagnostic.

If you have about 20 minutes, read in this order: introduction, the statement and intuition of Theorem 3.1, the fixed-sequence scoring experiment in §4.2, the reveal-order analysis in §4.3, and the benchmark correlation results in §4.4. One subtle point to keep in mind is that the paper does not claim low variance alone guarantees better task performance. The claim is narrower and more useful: variance is a complementary signal that captures decoding reliability better than total logP alone. The natural follow-up questions are whether training can explicitly enforce path consistency, and whether the observed 0.49 nats/token order drift shrinks or grows at larger dLLM scales.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接影响你怎么看 dLLM 的 likelihood 和 decode order；先看 chain-rule deviation 和 uniform-spreading theorem，两处都在修正“order-agnostic 就等于 joint-consistent”的直觉。
recommendation.en: This changes how you should read dLLM likelihoods and decode orders; start with the chain-rule deviation result and the uniform-spreading theorem, both of which push against the easy 'order-agnostic implies joint-consistent' intuition.

paper.title: ART: Attention Run-time Termination for Efficient Large Language Model Decoding

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长上下文解码里的一个很具体、也很硬的瓶颈：注意力计算并不总是需要把全部 KV cache 都读完，但现有方法大多在解码前用 key-only 规则做静态裁剪，无法在真正执行 attention 时根据 key 和 value 的联合作用决定“后面的 KV block 还值不值得继续读”。论文要解决的核心问题，是如何在 FlashAttention 这类流式 kernel 内部，用几乎不增加额外开销的方式，在线判断当前 query 的注意力输出是否已经基本收敛，从而提前终止后续 KV block 的访存与计算。
summary.importance: 对基座研究本身，它不是训练范式论文，而是推理侧的 kernel-level 方法。但它有两点启发比较实在。第一，它指出现有大量 KV 管理方法把 token 重要性近似成 key 或 attention score 的函数，这个近似和最终输出影响并不一致；真正决定输出的是 softmax 权重和 value 向量共同形成的加权和。第二，它把“输出是否收敛”变成运行时信号，而不是预估信号，这种思路比离线 importance predictor 更贴近真实计算路径，也更容易和已有 pruning/eviction 方法叠加。量级上看，它更像一个可组合的系统优化模块，而不是改变解码范式的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 ART，Attention Run-time Termination。它利用 FlashAttention 的块式流式执行特性：KV 被分成多个 block 顺序处理，kernel 在每处理完一个 block 后，内部都会得到一次中间 attention 输出 O^(t)。论文的观察是，很多 query 的 O^(t) 会在遍历完整个 KV 序列之前就趋于稳定，后续 block 对输出的增量很小。

因此 ART 不再提前预测哪些 token 重要，而是在 kernel 执行过程中直接监控中间输出的变化。终止判据不是单看幅值变化，也不是单看方向变化，而是同时看两件事：
1. scale stability：连续若干步中，输出更新量的范数是否已经足够小；
2. directional stability：更新方向是否已经和当前输出方向基本一致，说明后续只是在做很小的同向修正，而不是还存在明显的方向性重写。

这种设计的关键点在于，它试图近似“剩余未处理 KV 对最终输出的边际贡献是否可忽略”。只看 attention score 不够，因为高权重 token 的 value 可能接近零，低权重 token 的 value 也可能在某个方向上产生显著偏移。ART 直接在输出空间判断收敛，等于把 key-value 联合作用隐式纳入了判据。

从实现上，它嵌入在 block-wise attention kernel 内部，不需要额外训练 predictor，也不需要在解码前做离线分析。因为中间状态本来就在 FlashAttention 的 streaming softmax 过程中存在，所以额外成本主要是少量统计量维护和阈值判断。论文还强调它与已有 key-based KV 管理方法正交：先用外部方法缩小候选 KV，再由 ART 在运行时进一步提前停止，二者可以叠加。
summary.experiments:
实验主要在长上下文生成场景和 LongBench 上做，关注吞吐、延迟和质量保持。论文给出的主结论是：在大 batch 解码时，相比已有基线，ART 带来超过 20% 的 generation throughput 提升，同时生成质量损失可以忽略。这个结果的重要前提是 ART 不是单独替代所有 KV 管理方法，而是作为运行时 refinement 模块叠加到现有方法上，因此收益来自两部分：减少无效 KV block 读取，以及减少对应的 attention 计算。

从文中描述看，作者做了几类关键分析：
1. 输出收敛性可视化：展示 O^(t) 随 block 处理快速收敛，说明“提前停”不是拍脑袋，而是 attention kernel 的常见行为；
2. key-only 信号失配案例：给出 attention score 与真实输出影响不一致的例子，支撑 value-aware 的必要性；
3. 阈值与质量权衡：不同 termination threshold 下，吞吐提升和任务精度之间存在平滑 trade-off；
4. 与已有 KV 方法组合：ART 叠加后仍能继续提速，说明它捕捉到的是静态裁剪没覆盖的运行时冗余。

摘要里没有给出完整模型规模、上下文长度和全部 benchmark 数字；如果要复现或判断泛化性，需要重点看实验节里具体使用的 backbone、batch size、prompt/generation 长度，以及不同任务上质量退化是否均匀。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，重点不是理论，而是机制和实现边界。

建议先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1/2/3/4，先建立三个判断：为什么 key-only pruning 不够；FlashAttention 为什么天然暴露中间输出；中间输出为什么会提前收敛。然后精看方法部分里 termination criterion 的定义，尤其是 scale 和 direction 两个稳定性量是怎么计算的、窗口长度和阈值怎么设、是否按 head 或 token 粒度判断。这里决定了方法是否稳，以及是否容易在不同模型上迁移。

实验部分重点看三类表图：
1. throughput/latency 提升在不同 batch size 下的变化；
2. 与现有 KV pruning/eviction 方法叠加后的收益；
3. 质量退化最明显的任务类型，判断 ART 是否更适合检索型长上下文，而不太适合需要远距离稀疏关键信息的任务。

如果只花 20-30 分钟，读方法总览、终止判据、主结果表和一组消融就够了。更值得深挖的点有两个：一是终止判据是否能给出误差上界，二是这种 output-convergence 信号能否反过来用于训练时的稀疏注意力或自适应上下文建模。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a concrete bottleneck in long-context decoding: many attention computations do not need to read the entire KV cache, yet most prior methods make static, key-centric pruning decisions before decoding. That misses the fact that the final attention output depends on keys and values jointly. The core problem here is how to decide, during FlashAttention-style execution and with negligible overhead, whether the attention output for a query has already stabilized enough that the remaining KV blocks can be skipped.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-side systems paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it carries two useful lessons for foundation-model work. First, it makes explicit that key-only importance proxies are misaligned with actual output influence; the output is determined by the weighted sum over values, not by attention scores alone. Second, it replaces offline importance estimation with a runtime convergence signal taken from the real computation path. That makes the method more faithful to actual model behavior and naturally composable with existing KV pruning or eviction schemes. The contribution is best viewed as a practical kernel-level refinement, not a change in the decoding paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, ART (Attention Run-time Termination), exploits a property of FlashAttention-style blockwise execution. Keys and values are processed block by block, and after each block the kernel already maintains an intermediate attention output O^(t). The paper observes that for many queries, O^(t) stabilizes well before all KV blocks are consumed.

Instead of predicting token importance ahead of time, ART monitors the evolution of these intermediate outputs during kernel execution. The termination rule is based on output stability in two senses:
1. scale stability: whether the norm of the incremental update has become sufficiently small over recent steps;
2. directional stability: whether the update direction is no longer meaningfully changing the output direction, indicating only minor same-direction corrections remain.

This matters because attention-score-based criteria are incomplete. A token can receive nontrivial attention weight but contribute little if its value vector is uninformative; conversely, a lower-weight token can still shift the output in an important direction through its value. By checking convergence directly in output space, ART implicitly captures the joint effect of keys and values.

Implementation-wise, ART is inserted into the blockwise attention kernel itself. It does not require a learned predictor, offline preprocessing, or extra passes over the cache. Since the relevant intermediate states already exist in the streaming softmax computation, the added cost is mainly lightweight bookkeeping and threshold checks. The paper also emphasizes orthogonality: ART can be layered on top of existing key-based KV management methods, acting as a runtime refinement after static candidate reduction.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. The main value is in the mechanism and its implementation boundary, not in deep theory.

Start with the introduction and the early figures. Three questions matter: why key-only pruning is insufficient, why FlashAttention naturally exposes intermediate outputs, and why those outputs often converge early. Then read the termination criterion carefully: how scale and direction are defined, whether stability is tracked per head or per token, and how thresholds or windows are chosen. That part determines whether the method is robust and portable.

In the experiments, focus on three things:
1. how throughput gains change with batch size;
2. whether ART still helps when combined with existing KV pruning or eviction methods;
3. which task types show the largest quality drop, if any.

A 20-30 minute read is enough for the method overview, the criterion, the main result table, and one ablation. The deeper questions are whether the stopping rule can be tied to an error bound, and whether the same output-convergence signal could inform adaptive sparse attention during training.

recommendation.zh: 这类工作常见问题是 wall-clock 不兑现或只在 toy setup 有效；先看是否真和 FlashAttention+KV cache 兼容，再决定要不要细读。
recommendation.en: These papers often save FLOPs but not latency; first check real wall-clock gains on top of FlashAttention and KV cache before spending time.

paper.title: Self-Consistency via Marginal Sharpening
paper.abstract: Inference-time sampling can elicit strong reasoning abilities from language models without additional training. Existing power-sampling methods do so by sharpening the distribution over full generated outputs, favoring completions that are individually likely under the model. We argue that this is the wrong object to target for reasoning: a completion entangles a reasoning trace with a final answer, whereas what matters is whether an answer is supported by many plausible reasoning paths. We ther

summary.core_problem: 推理型 LM 的输出可以拆成“隐式推理轨迹 + 最终答案”。现有 inference-time 强化（majority vote 的 self-consistency、以及对整段 completion 做 power sampling）都在“整段字符串”层面聚合或锐化，导致把不同推理轨迹但同一答案的支持度打散，尤其在代码/证明等结构化输出里更严重。论文要解决的是：如何把 test-time compute 用在“答案边缘分布（answer marginal）”上，而不是用在“完整轨迹分布（trajectory / completion）”上，从而更贴近‘一个答案被多少条合理推理路径支持’这一目标。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是 recipe 级贡献，但对“推理作为潜变量”的建模视角很清晰：把 self-consistency 从事后投票提升为一个显式的 inference-time 目标（sharpened answer marginal）。这对两类方向有直接启发：1）post-train / RL 里做 process vs outcome 信号设计时，应该更明确地区分‘轨迹似然’与‘答案支持度’；2）若未来在预训练或中期训练里引入 any-order / latent-variable 目标，这个分解提供了可操作的近似路径（用标准 AR 模型近似采样一个“答案级”目标分布）。
summary.technical_approach:
核心做法是把推理轨迹 z 视为潜变量、答案 y 为观测目标，定义基础模型给出的答案边缘分布 p(y|x)=\sum_z p(z,y|x)。然后定义“边缘锐化”目标：q_\alpha(y|x) \propto p(y|x)^\alpha（\alpha>1），即放大那些在边缘分布上概率更高的答案——这对应‘被更多潜在推理路径支持’的答案。

关键推导在于：当 \alpha 为整数时，p(y|x)^\alpha 可以写成多条独立轨迹样本的乘积形式，从而把“对边缘分布做幂次锐化”的目标，转成“从多条轨迹中提取 token 级共识信号”的可计算对象。基于这个分解，论文给出一个轻量的并行 AR 解码近似：
1）先从模型采样 K 条完整 completion（包含推理轨迹 + 答案段），把它们视为潜变量样本；
2）在生成最终答案时，不再选某一条 completion 的答案段，而是对答案段逐 token 聚合来自 K 条轨迹的支持（直观上类似 product-of-experts / vote-at-token-level，但目标来自边缘锐化的推导，而不是拍脑袋的启发式）；
3）用这个聚合后的 token 分布解码出单个答案。

论文还讨论了一个可选的 sequential importance sampling（SIS）校正版本，用重要性权重更贴近真实的 q_\alpha，但主实验以并行近似为主，强调实现简单、可并行、对长推理更省时。

与 power sampling 的区别：power sampling 锐化的是 p(z,y|x)（整段序列），会偏向‘某一条最像训练分布的完整推理稿’，而不是偏向‘答案层面有广泛支持’；边缘锐化则显式把不同轨迹对同一答案的支持累加后再锐化。
summary.experiments:
论文在数学推理与代码生成基准上比较 temperature sampling、majority voting self-consistency、sequence-level power sampling、以及 marginal sharpening。文中给出的定性结论是：
- 数学推理：marginal sharpening 的最终答案准确率接近 majority voting（因为数学答案往往短且易 canonicalize，字符串投票本身就很强），但优于 power sampling。
- 代码生成：marginal sharpening 明显更占优，并给出“代码基准上最好结果”的表述，原因是代码的‘同解多形’更严重，字符串级投票与序列级锐化都会碎片化支持度。
- 计算效率：在长推理问题上，相比需要对完整序列做更重采样/重打分的 power sampling，marginal sharpening 在相同或更好的效果下可达到最高约 38× 的速度优势（论文表述为 up to 38× faster）。

消融方向包括：锐化强度 \alpha、轨迹样本数 K、并行近似 vs SIS 校正、固定 compute 分配策略等；附录 B 给全表，附录 C 评估 SIS 版本。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 重点看 §2（把 completion 切成 latent trace + answer，并定义 answer marginal），这是全文的“对象选择”转折点。
- 重点看 §3 的整数 \alpha 分解：它解释了为什么可以用多轨迹的 token 级聚合来近似采样 sharpened marginal，而不是停留在‘更聪明的投票’。
- 直接翻 §5 的代码基准结果与 runtime 对比，再回看方法细节理解为什么代码场景收益更大。
- 如果关心严格性与偏差来源，读附录 C（SIS 校正）了解近似误差与代价。

summary_en.core_problem: Reasoning-oriented LMs produce outputs that mix a latent reasoning trace with a final answer. Common inference-time methods either (a) vote over full strings (self-consistency) or (b) sharpen the distribution over full completions (power sampling). Both operate at the trajectory/string level, so they fragment support when many different traces correspond to the same underlying answer—especially in structured domains like code and proofs. The paper targets a more appropriate object: the answer marginal aggregated over latent traces, and asks how to sharpen and sample from that marginal efficiently using standard autoregressive models.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining recipe paper, but it sharpens the latent-variable view of reasoning in a way that matters for foundation-model work: it turns self-consistency from a post-hoc voting heuristic into an explicit inference-time objective (a sharpened answer marginal). This clarifies the mismatch between “likely transcript” and “well-supported answer,” which is relevant when designing process/outcome signals in post-training and when considering latent-variable or any-order objectives that might later feed back into mid-training or continual pretraining.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluations cover math reasoning and code generation, comparing temperature sampling, majority-vote self-consistency, sequence-level power sampling, and marginal sharpening. Reported takeaways:
- Math: marginal sharpening stays close to majority voting (string-level voting is strong when answers are short/canonicalizable) while improving over power sampling.
- Code: marginal sharpening performs best among compared inference-time methods, consistent with higher “same-solution/different-surface-form” variability.
- Efficiency: on long-reasoning problems, the proposed approach can be up to ~38× faster than power-sampling-style methods while improving final-answer performance.
Ablations vary sharpening strength \alpha, number of traces K, approximation choices, and compute allocation; full tables are in Appendix B, SIS details in Appendix C.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 min):
- §2 for the modeling choice (trace vs answer) and the definition of the answer marginal.
- §3 for the integer-\alpha decomposition; this is where the method becomes more than “smarter voting.”
- Jump to §5 for code-generation results and runtime comparisons, then backtrack to connect gains to the marginal-vs-sequence distinction.
- Appendix C if you care about approximation bias and what SIS correction buys you.

recommendation.zh: 只看目标分布推导和采样算法即可；它修正了 power sampling 的对象，但对预训练侧只是 test-time compute 的弱信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the target-distribution derivation and sampler; it fixes what power sampling sharpens, but remains a weak pretraining-side signal.

paper.title: Beyond Temperature: Hyperfitting as a Late-Stage Geometric Expansion
paper.abstract: Recent work has identified a counterintuitive phenomenon termed "Hyperfitting", where fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) to near-zero training loss on small datasets surprisingly enhances open-ended generation quality and mitigates repetition in greedy decoding. While effective, the underlying mechanism remains poorly understood, with the extremely low-entropy output distributions suggesting a potential equivalence to simple temperature scaling. In this work, we demonstrate that this pheno

summary.core_problem: 解释“Hyperfitting”（在极小数据上把训练损失压到接近 0）为何能在贪心解码下显著减少重复、提升开放式生成多样性；并判定它是否只是温度缩放/分布变尖或静态词表偏置的等价物。
summary.importance: 这篇工作把一个看似“反常识”的后期训练现象拆成可检验的机制假设，并给出较强的反证链条：Hyperfitting 的收益不是简单的 entropy 变低，而是发生了上下文相关的 top-1 重新排序。对预训练/中后期训练的启发在于：生成退化（repetition loop）可能更多是“决策边界/表示几何”问题，而不是采样温度问题；同时它暗示了一个更工程化的路径——只在末端层做小范围适配就能改写解码行为，可能成为 cooldown/mid-train 的一个轻量工具。
summary.technical_approach:
全文围绕三个竞争解释做“控制变量 + 反证”：
1) 温度缩放等价假设：如果 Hyperfitting 只是把分布变尖（不改 token 排序），那么通过 temperature 调到同等低熵应能复现多样性提升。作者做了 entropy-matched 对照：把基座模型解码温度调到与 hyperfitted 模型输出熵相当的水平，再比较 TTR/重复率，发现完全复现不了。
2) 静态词表重加权假设：如果只是学到一个全局 logit bias（某些 token 永久升/降权），那可以用“合成注入”的方式把这种 bias 加回去复现效果。作者的 ablation 显示这种静态 reweighting 更像破坏性噪声，不能产生同样的 rank reordering，指向“动态、上下文相关”的重排。
3) 机制定位：作者把 hyperfitting 视为一种 late-stage 的几何扩张（Terminal Expansion）。通过层级分析指出：早期层的语言特征基本保留，关键变化集中在最后一层（或末端少数层）——表示的有效维度显著上升（文中给出 ΔDim ≈ +80.8），从而让长尾候选在特定上下文里被“抬到”top-1，压制局部最优但容易导致循环的高频 token。
在此基础上给出工程化推论：既然变化主要在末端层，就不需要全参 hyperfit。提出 Late-Stage LoRA：只适配最后 5 层即可复现主要的 rank reordering 动力学，作为更省算的替代。
summary.experiments:
复现实验设置清晰：以 TinyLlama-1.1B 做主要机制分析，超饱和训练协议为 2,000 样本、260 epochs、weight decay=0，训练损失趋近 0，同时验证困惑度变差，呈现“likelihood-质量解耦”。
关键对照结果（文中明确给数）：在 entropy-matched 条件下，温度缩放模型的多样性与重复显著劣于 hyperfitted：TTR 约 0.40 vs 0.68；重复指标约 0.60 vs 0.14（对应论文主文 3.2/3.3 的结论）。
泛化性：除 TinyLlama 外，还在 Qwen2.5-1.5B、LLaMA-3.2-3B、Gemma-2-2B 以及更大的 instruct checkpoints（LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct）上做验证（细节在附录），用来支持“现象不依赖单一架构/单一 checkpoint”。
机制消融：静态 logit 注入/重加权被证明无法复现，且表现为破坏性噪声（主文 3.5）。
效率实验：Late-Stage LoRA（仅最后 5 层）可在较低改动下复现主要效果（主文 5）。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“假设—对照—定位—工程化”顺序读：
- 先看 Fig.1 的 rank reordering 直觉图，明确作者要证明的不是“更尖”，而是“换赢家”。
- 精读 3.2/3.3：entropy-matched 的设计细节决定了反证力度（如何匹配熵、用什么解码/统计口径）。
- 精读 3.5：静态 bias 注入的构造方式与负结果解释，能帮助判断作者排除了哪些简单替代解释。
- 精读第 4 节：Terminal Expansion 的度量（ΔDim 的定义、如何做层级几何分析）是全文最“可迁移”的方法部分。
- 最后看第 5 节：Late-Stage LoRA 的层选择、是否需要同时改 K/Q/V/MLP、以及与全参 hyperfit 的差距。若要复现或迁移到自家模型，这一节最直接。

summary_en.core_problem: Explain why “hyperfitting” (driving training loss to near-zero on a tiny dataset) can improve open-ended generation under greedy decoding—especially reducing repetition—and determine whether it is merely equivalent to temperature scaling or a static vocabulary bias.
summary_en.importance: The paper turns a puzzling late-stage fine-tuning phenomenon into testable mechanistic hypotheses and provides fairly direct falsification for the two most obvious explanations (entropy sharpening and global logit reweighting). For pretraining/mid-training practice, the key takeaway is that repetition loops can be a representation/decision-boundary issue rather than a decoding-temperature issue, and that the intervention may be localized to late layers—suggesting a lightweight “cooldown-like” adaptation knob (e.g., late-layer LoRA) instead of full-model retraining.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The study is structured as controlled comparisons plus mechanism localization:
- Entropy-matched control against temperature scaling: if hyperfitting only sharpens distributions without changing token ranking, then adjusting temperature to match the hyperfitted model’s low entropy should reproduce the diversity gains. It does not, implying rank changes.
- Falsifying static vocabulary bias: they test whether a global logit bias could explain the effect via synthetic bias injection / reweighting ablations. The injected bias behaves like destructive noise and fails to reproduce the observed behavior, pointing to context-dependent (dynamic) rank reordering.
- Mechanistic localization via geometry: they argue hyperfitting induces a “terminal expansion” concentrated in the final transformer layer(s). Early layers largely preserve linguistic features, while late layers undergo a substantial effective-dimensional expansion (reported ΔDim ≈ +80.8), enabling long-tail candidates to be promoted to top-1 in context and suppressing locally-attractive repetitive tokens.
- Efficiency implication: because the effect is late-layer localized, they propose Late-Stage LoRA—adapting only the last ~5 layers—to recover the rank-reordering dynamics without full-parameter hyperfitting.
summary_en.experiments:
Main mechanistic vehicle: TinyLlama-1.1B with a hyper-saturation recipe (2,000 samples, 260 epochs, no weight decay) reaching near-zero training loss while validation perplexity worsens, demonstrating likelihood–quality decoupling.
Key quantitative evidence (explicit in the paper): under entropy-matched conditions, temperature scaling fails to match hyperfitting on diversity and repetition—TTR ~0.40 vs 0.68 and repetition metric ~0.60 vs 0.14 (sections 3.2/3.3).
Generality checks span multiple base models (Qwen2.5-1.5B, LLaMA-3.2-3B, Gemma-2-2B) and larger instruct checkpoints (LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct), with details in appendices.
Ablations: static logit reweighting / synthetic injection fails (section 3.5).
Efficiency: Late-Stage LoRA on the last 5 layers is reported sufficient to reproduce the core behavior (section 5).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read in the order that matches the claim stack:
1) Fig. 1 to internalize the central claim: hyperfitting changes the winner (rank reordering), not just confidence.
2) Sections 3.2–3.3 for the entropy-matched protocol; the exact matching procedure determines how strong the “not temperature” conclusion is.
3) Section 3.5 for the static-bias falsification; focus on how the synthetic bias is constructed and why it degrades.
4) Section 4 for the “terminal expansion” measurement (how ΔDim is defined/estimated and how layerwise localization is done).
5) Section 5 for the practical recipe (which layers, what LoRA targets) if you want to replicate or port the effect.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 entropy-matched control 和最后层分析；若复现实验成立，应重新检查小数据过拟合对 logit 几何的作用。
recommendation.en: Read the entropy-matched controls and final-layer analysis; if reproducible, it forces a recheck of how small-data overfitting reshapes logit geometry.

paper.title: Mix-Quant: Quantized Prefilling, Precise Decoding for Agentic LLMs
paper.abstract: LLM agents have recently emerged as a powerful paradigm for solving complex tasks through planning, tool use, memory retrieval, and multi-step interaction. However, these agentic workflows often introduce substantial input-side overhead, making the compute-intensive prefilling stage a key bottleneck in long-context, multi-turn inference. In this work, we propose Mix-Quant, a simple and effective phase-aware quantization framework for fast agentic inference. We first investigate FP4 quantization

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 agentic LLM 推理里的一个很具体但常被混在一起的问题：长上下文、多轮工具调用场景下，prefill 和 decode 的误差容忍度与算力瓶颈并不相同，若对整个推理过程统一做激进量化，往往会在复杂轨迹任务上明显掉点。论文要解决的是，能否只在真正算力吃紧、且对量化更宽容的 prefilling 阶段使用超低比特计算，同时保住 decoding 阶段的数值稳定性与最终任务成功率。
summary.importance: 对基座研究本身，它不是预训练方法论文，而是推理效率论文；但它有两个值得记住的启发。第一，长上下文 agent workload 的主瓶颈常常不在 autoregressive decode，而在反复处理超长输入的 prefill，这和很多只盯 decode 吞吐的优化思路不同。第二，推理阶段并不是一个同质过程，prefill/decode 的最优精度配置可以不同，这种 phase-aware 设计对后续训练侧也有启发，例如是否可以在训练中区分 prompt encoding 与 target generation 的数值预算、缓存策略或蒸馏目标。贡献量级偏工程实用，核心价值在于把“分阶段量化”这件事用 agentic 长轨迹场景讲清楚，并给出较完整的实证。
summary.technical_approach: 方法本身很直接：Mix-Quant 在 prefilling 阶段使用 NVFP4 的 weight-and-activation quantization，在 decoding 阶段保留 BF16。论文的判断依据有两层。其一，prefill 是并行处理固定输入序列，主要受矩阵乘计算量约束；decode 是逐 token 自回归生成，更偏 memory-bound，同时每一步输出都会反馈到后续输入，因此量化误差会沿轨迹累积。其二，agentic 场景的输入往往包含大量历史对话、工具返回、检索片段和环境状态，冗余高，prefill 对低精度更不敏感。实现上，作者依赖 Blackwell 上原生支持的 NVFP4 microscaling FP4 格式，让低比特 matmul 真正落到硬件吞吐上，而不是只做 weight-only 压缩。和常见 INT4 weight-only PTQ 相比，它能加速 compute-bound prefill；和全程 W/A 低比特相比，它避免了 decode 端误差滚雪球。论文的创新不在新量化算法，而在把推理阶段解耦，并把硬件格式、误差传播机制和 agent 工作负载特征对齐。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两类任务：长上下文 benchmark 与多轮 agent benchmark，并在多种 agentic base model 上测试。摘要与正文给出的主结论比较稳定：相较 BF16，Mix-Quant 在不同 batch size 和 sequence length 下可取得约 2–3× 的 prefill 加速；相较全程 NVFP4 量化，它能在大多数长轨迹任务上显著更好地保留最终性能。论文强调的不是单点峰值，而是效率—质量折中：uniform NVFP4 虽然更激进，但在复杂 agent 任务上成功率下降更明显；Mix-Quant 则把损失主要限制在可接受范围内。值得注意的是，作者把 prefilling 识别为主耗时阶段这一点，是通过 agent workflow 的输入输出长度比和多轮交互累积成本来支撑的，而不是只看单轮生成。若精读正文，建议重点核对不同上下文长度下的 latency breakdown、不同模型上的成功率变化，以及是否报告了 end-to-end wall-clock 而不仅是 kernel-level prefill speedup。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 里对 agent workload 的拆解，再看方法部分关于“为什么 prefill 能量化、decode 不宜激进量化”的误差传播解释，这两处已经覆盖了主要思想。随后直接看实验总表和 latency/success-rate 对比图，确认三件事：一是 prefill 在 agent 场景里是否真是主瓶颈；二是 uniform NVFP4 的性能损失有多大；三是 Mix-Quant 的收益主要来自哪里。预计 15–20 分钟可以抓住核心。若只关心是否值得复现，重点看不同 sequence length、batch size 下的 speedup 曲线，以及多轮 agent benchmark 上的任务成功率。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific inference issue in agentic LLM workloads: prefilling and decoding have different bottlenecks and very different tolerance to quantization noise, yet many deployment pipelines still apply one uniform precision policy to both. In long-context, multi-turn agent settings, this often hurts task success because aggressive low-bit quantization saves compute in prefill but introduces compounding errors during autoregressive decoding. The question here is whether one can quantize only the phase that is both expensive and relatively redundant, while keeping the fragile phase precise.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper; it is an inference-efficiency paper. Still, it carries two useful lessons for foundation-model researchers. First, in realistic agent workloads the dominant cost may shift from token-by-token decoding to repeated long-context prefilling, which changes where optimization effort should go. Second, inference is not a homogeneous process: different phases justify different numerical budgets. That phase-aware view may later matter for training-time system design as well, such as prompt/target asymmetry, cache policies, or distillation objectives. The contribution is mainly practical and systems-oriented rather than algorithmically deep, but it makes the trade-off unusually explicit.
summary_en.technical_approach: Mix-Quant applies NVFP4 weight-and-activation quantization only during prefilling, while keeping decoding in BF16. The rationale is straightforward but well argued. Prefill processes a fixed context in parallel and is compute-bound, so low-bit matmuls can directly reduce latency. Decode is autoregressive and more sensitive because each generated token becomes future input; quantization error therefore propagates across the trajectory. The paper also argues that agentic contexts contain substantial redundancy—conversation history, tool outputs, retrieved passages, environment state—so prefill can tolerate more approximation. Compared with weight-only INT4 PTQ, this approach can accelerate compute-heavy prefill rather than only memory-bound decode. Compared with full-path low-bit quantization, it avoids error accumulation in generation. The novelty is less about inventing a new quantizer and more about decomposing inference into phases and matching hardware support, workload structure, and numerical sensitivity.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers both long-context benchmarks and multi-turn agent benchmarks, using several agent-oriented base models. The main empirical claim is consistent across the paper: Mix-Quant delivers roughly 2–3× prefill speedup over BF16 across different sequence lengths and batch sizes, while preserving task performance much better than uniform NVFP4 quantization. The key comparison is not peak speed alone but the efficiency-quality frontier. Full NVFP4 is more aggressive, yet it degrades success rates more noticeably on long-horizon agent tasks; Mix-Quant recovers much of that loss by keeping decode precise. A careful read should verify whether the paper reports end-to-end wall-clock gains in addition to kernel-level prefill speedups, and how the latency breakdown changes as context length grows.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction’s decomposition of agent workloads, then read the method section that explains why prefill is quantization-tolerant while decode is not. Those two parts contain nearly all of the paper’s real insight. After that, jump to the main tables and latency-versus-performance figures. Check three things: whether prefill is indeed the dominant bottleneck in their workloads, how much quality is lost under uniform NVFP4, and how much of Mix-Quant’s gain survives in end-to-end settings. A 15–20 minute skim is enough to capture the contribution. If deciding on reproduction value, focus on the speedup curves over sequence length and batch size, plus task success on the multi-turn agent benchmarks.

recommendation.zh: 结论不新奇但很干净：prefill 比 decode 更耐低精度，做 serving 或长上下文实验的人应直接复现；只看 phase split 的消融和不同任务上的精度坍塌点。
recommendation.en: The punchline is simple but clean: prefill tolerates low precision much better than decode; if you care about serving or long-context workloads, reproduce the phase split and inspect where accuracy collapses.

paper.title: Differences in Text Generated by Diffusion and Autoregressive Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) are promising alternatives to autoregressive language models (ARMs), yet the intrinsic differences in their generated text remain underexplored. We first find empirically that off-the-shelf DLMs exhibit lower $n$-gram entropy, higher semantic coherence, and higher semantic diversity. To understand the cause, we conduct controlled experiments that decouple the effects of training objectives and decoding algorithms. Results suggest that the DLM training objective c

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“DLM 能不能和 AR 打平”，而是更细的一层：在相近训练预算下，diffusion language model 生成出来的文本，到底在哪些统计性质上系统性不同，这些差异来自训练目标还是解码过程。作者把问题拆成三个层次：token 级的 n-gram entropy、句子级的 semantic coherence、文档级的 semantic diversity。进一步，他们用受控实验把 DLM 的几个关键成分拆开，想弄清楚究竟是双向上下文、masking 机制、loss weighting，还是 remasking decoding 在驱动这些差异。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值主要有两点。第一，它把“新型 LM 范式的行为差异”从 benchmark 分数拉回到生成分布层面，这对判断 DLM 是否只是另一种训练技巧，还是在建模偏好上与 AR 真有不同，很关键。第二，它给出一个比较清楚的归因：语义一致性和语义多样性的提升，主要来自双向上下文的训练目标；而 entropy 的下降并不是 DLM 目标天然导致的，更多是 confidence-based remasking 解码带来的。这一点很重要，因为它把‘模型学到了什么’和‘解码器把分布压成什么样’区分开了。对后续做 diffusion LM、masked/any-order LM、甚至 AR+non-AR 混合范式的人，这个结论直接影响训练目标设计和采样策略设计。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上分两部分。第一部分是对现成模型做行为测量。作者收集了 20 个 off-the-shelf DLM 和 ARM，在统一生成设置下比较三类指标：n-gram entropy 作为 token-level 随机性的代理；semantic coherence 衡量相邻句子或局部语义连贯性；semantic diversity 衡量整篇文档层面的语义覆盖和变化。结论是，现成 DLM 通常表现为更低 entropy、更高 coherence、更高 diversity。

第二部分是归因实验。作者没有停留在相关性，而是构造了共享解码设置下的目标函数对比，并做 objective interpolation，把 DLM 与 ARM 之间的差异逐步拆开。DLM 目标包含几个成分：从 noised input 做 mask prediction、使用双向上下文、输入 masking、label masking、以及按噪声水平加权的 weighting function。实验显示，真正起主要作用的是 bidirectional context；其他成分如 input masking、label masking、1/t 一类 weighting，对 coherence 和 diversity 的边际影响都小得多。

第三部分是 decoding 分析。作者聚焦 block-wise iterative decoding，并比较四种 remasking：low-confidence、dynamic low-confidence、high-entropy、random。关键发现是 entropy 的下降主要出现在 confidence-based remasking 下。直觉上，这类策略会优先保留模型最有把握的位置，把不确定位置反复重采样，等价于持续做一种偏向高置信 token 的截断式搜索，因此会把最终样本分布压窄。相反，random 或 high-entropy remasking 不会明显降低整体 entropy，生成文本的 entropy 大致维持在 AR 水平。文中还给了理论解释，说明 remasking 规则如何改变最终采样分布，而不是仅仅改变收敛速度。
summary.experiments:
关键实验分三组。第一组是 20 个现成模型的总体比较，结论稳定：DLM 相比 ARM，n-gram entropy 更低，但 semantic coherence 和 semantic diversity 更高。这里作者强调 entropy 用 n-gram proxy 近似 full entropy，因此更适合做相对比较，不宜过度解读为精确的信息论量。

第二组是训练目标受控实验。在共享 decoding setup 下，作者把 DLM 目标逐步改造成更接近 ARM，或反过来插值，观察三项指标如何变化。结果显示：只要保留 bidirectional context，coherence 和 diversity 的提升大体还在；去掉双向条件后，这两个优势明显减弱。masking 细节和 weighting function 的影响相对次要。这说明 DLM 与 AR 在语义层面的差异，不是“扩散”这个名字本身带来的，而是来自训练时是否允许模型同时看左右文。

第三组是 decoding 消融。作者比较 low-confidence、dynamic low-confidence、high-entropy、random remasking。结论最明确的是：confidence-based remasking 会显著拉低 entropy，并使 DLM 的 entropy 低于 ARM；而其他 remasking 策略下，DLM 的 entropy 基本不变，接近 ARM。也就是说，很多人观察到的“DLM 文本更保守、更低熵”，很大一部分是解码器选择造成的，不应直接归因到训练目标。

从论文给出的信息看，这篇工作的重点不是刷新某个 benchmark，而是把行为差异做成可复现实验事实，并给出较干净的因果拆分。这类实验设计比单纯报分更有参考价值。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先看三处。第一，看引言和结果总览，确认作者到底比较的是哪三类文本属性，以及为什么把 entropy、coherence、diversity 分别对应到 token / sentence / document 三个层次。第二，看第 4 节的 objective-controlled experiments，这部分是全文最有信息量的地方，尤其是 objective interpolation 和对 bidirectional context 的归因。第三，看第 5 节 decoding analysis，重点关注不同 remasking strategy 对 entropy 的影响，以及理论解释如何把经验现象说清楚。

如果时间有限，优先看 Figure 1、训练目标拆解相关图表、以及 remasking 消融表。预计 25 到 40 分钟可以抓住主结论。若你在做 diffusion LM 或 any-order LM，值得多花时间看作者如何控制“同一解码器下比较训练目标”与“同一目标下比较解码器”，这套实验框架可以直接借用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a more precise question than whether diffusion LMs are competitive with autoregressive LMs: what intrinsic properties of generated text differ systematically between the two, and which part of the pipeline causes the difference. The analysis is organized at three levels: token-level n-gram entropy, sentence-level semantic coherence, and document-level semantic diversity. The central goal is causal disentanglement: are the observed differences due to the DLM training objective itself, or due to iterative decoding and remasking heuristics?
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is in separating modeling effects from decoding effects. Many recent discussions around diffusion LMs mix together objective design, bidirectional conditioning, and non-AR decoding. This paper shows that the gains in semantic coherence and semantic diversity are largely tied to the bidirectional training signal, while the commonly observed entropy reduction is mostly a decoding artifact from confidence-based remasking. That is a useful correction. It means one should not attribute all behavioral differences to the diffusion objective per se. For researchers working on diffusion LM, masked/any-order LM, or hybrid AR/non-AR paradigms, this directly informs both objective design and sampler design.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper has three layers of analysis. First, it evaluates 20 off-the-shelf DLMs and ARMs under a common generation setup using three metrics: n-gram entropy as a proxy for token-level randomness, semantic coherence for local sentence-level consistency, and semantic diversity for document-level variation. The empirical pattern is consistent: DLM outputs tend to have lower entropy, higher coherence, and higher diversity.

Second, it runs controlled objective studies. Instead of only comparing end-to-end systems, the authors align decoding and vary the training objective. They interpolate between ARM-like and DLM-like objectives and isolate components such as bidirectional context, input masking, label masking, and noise-level weighting. The main finding is that bidirectional context is the dominant driver of the coherence and diversity gains. Other ingredients of the DLM objective contribute much less.

Third, it studies decoding. The focus is block-wise iterative decoding with four remasking strategies: low-confidence, dynamic low-confidence, high-entropy, and random remasking. The key result is that entropy reduction is strongly tied to confidence-based remasking. Intuitively, these strategies repeatedly preserve high-confidence positions and revisit uncertain ones, which narrows the effective sample distribution. In contrast, random or high-entropy remasking leaves entropy roughly unchanged and close to the ARM level. The paper also provides a theoretical account of why remasking changes the resulting distribution rather than merely affecting decoding efficiency.
summary_en.experiments:
There are three main experimental blocks. First, the large-scale comparison over 20 released models establishes the descriptive pattern: DLMs usually generate text with lower n-gram entropy but higher semantic coherence and semantic diversity than ARMs. The authors are careful to treat n-gram entropy as a proxy rather than a full entropy estimate.

Second, the controlled objective experiments are the most informative part. Under a shared decoding setup, the authors gradually move between DLM-style and ARM-style training formulations. The results show that keeping bidirectional context preserves most of the gains in coherence and diversity, while removing it substantially weakens them. By contrast, input masking details, label masking, and weighting functions have much smaller marginal effects.

Third, the decoding ablations compare low-confidence, dynamic low-confidence, high-entropy, and random remasking. Confidence-based remasking noticeably lowers entropy and pushes DLM outputs below ARM entropy. Other remasking strategies do not produce the same drop; entropy stays approximately at the ARM level. This is the paper's clearest causal claim: the low-entropy behavior often associated with DLMs is largely induced by the decoder.

The contribution is not a benchmark win but a careful behavioral decomposition with reasonably clean controls, which is more useful than another headline score comparison.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick but useful read, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and the metric definitions to understand why the authors chose entropy, coherence, and diversity as token-, sentence-, and document-level descriptors. Second, spend most of the time on the objective-controlled experiments in Section 4, especially the interpolation analysis and the evidence that bidirectional context is the main source of the semantic gains. Third, read the decoding analysis in Section 5, paying attention to how different remasking strategies affect entropy and how the theoretical explanation supports the empirical trend.

If time is limited, prioritize Figure 1, the objective ablation figures, and the remasking comparison tables. Around 25 to 40 minutes should be enough to extract the main claims. If you work on diffusion LM or any-order LM, the experimental methodology itself is worth studying because it cleanly separates objective effects from decoding effects.

recommendation.zh: 这篇最有价值的是把 DLM 的“目标优势”和“解码副作用”拆开了；先看 controlled setup 和 remasking 结论，能直接修正你对 diffusion LM 的 prior。
recommendation.en: Its real value is separating objective-level gains from decoding artifacts in DLMs; read the controlled setup and remasking result first, as it directly updates your prior on diffusion LMs.

institutions: Institute for Interdisciplinary Information Sciences, Tsinghua University

paper.title: Sampling More, Getting Less: Calibration is the Diversity Bottleneck in LLMs
paper.abstract: Diversity is essential for language-model applications ranging from creative generation to scientific discovery, yet modern LLMs often collapse into a narrow subset of plausible outputs. While prior work has developed benchmarks for measuring this lack of diversity, less is known about how the step-by-step probability distributions at inference time cause the problem. We introduce a validity--diversity framework that attributes diversity collapse to how an LLM allocates probability mass across v

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文关心的是：为什么扩大采样并不一定带来更多有效多样性。作者把问题定位到推理时的 next-token 分布，而不是只看最终生成文本的去重率或熵。核心结论是，LLM 的多样性瓶颈来自两类校准失败：有效 token 没有稳定排在无效 token 前面，称为 order calibration 问题；概率质量过度集中在少数有效 continuation 上，同时无效长尾仍占据大量概率空间，称为 shape calibration 问题。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把“生成多样性不足”从解码技巧问题推进到模型分布质量问题。温度、top-k、top-p、min-p 这类方法只能重排或截断已有分布，无法修复有效候选在排序和概率形状上的错误。如果这些错误来自预训练数据分布、训练目标或后训练偏好压缩，那么单靠 decoding 很难解决。这个框架也提醒预训练评估不能只看平均 loss 或 benchmark accuracy，还需要看模型是否把概率质量合理分配给多个有效答案。
summary.technical_approach: 作者建立了一个 validity-diversity 框架。validity 指模型分配给有效响应集合 V 的总概率质量；diversity 指在有效集合内部归一化后，分布的有效支持大小，具体用熵的指数形式刻画。这个定义有一个关键取舍：它假设所有有效响应同等可取，因此更适合用于存在明确有效集合的任务或可控诊断场景，而不直接等价于开放式写作质量。论文进一步把序列级问题拆到 token 级。order calibration 衡量有效 token 是否排在无效 token 之前；如果有效和无效 token 在排序中交错，任何基于排名的截断都会遇到取舍：截得窄会漏掉有效替代，截得宽会引入无效 token。shape calibration 衡量有效 token 内部的概率形状；如果少数头部有效 token 吃掉大部分概率，升温只会把质量从头部挪到长尾，其中相当一部分会流向无效 token，而不是流向低概率但有效的候选。作者还分析了局部校准错误如何随序列长度复合，解释为什么短步上的小偏差会在完整生成中表现为明显的模式坍缩。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 14 个不同家族和尺度的语言模型。作者设计了可控诊断任务，其中有效集合可以被精确定义，并引入 oracle cutoff 作为参照，用来区分“解码规则没选好”和“模型分布本身不适合截断”。结果显示，常见 top-token filtering 方法无法同时恢复高 validity 和高 diversity：放宽截断会引入更多无效 token，收紧截断会丢失有效替代。温度采样也表现出类似限制，升温后概率质量并不会只流向罕见有效 continuation，而会大量进入无效尾部。论文还用实际生成例子展示了输出集中现象，例如 GPT-4 生成故事数据中有 59% 以 “Once upon a time” 开头。这类例子不是主要证据，但有助于说明序列级坍缩的外在表现。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction 和方法定义部分，重点看 validity-diversity 的形式化、order calibration 与 shape calibration 的区分，以及 oracle cutoff 诊断的设计。实验部分优先看比较不同 decoding 方法的图表，以及展示局部错误随长度累积的分析。预计阅读 25 到 35 分钟。值得深挖的问题是：这些校准失败是否能通过预训练数据去重、反模式数据平衡、熵正则、multi-answer 训练目标或后训练偏好数据改造来缓解。对只做解码策略的人，这篇论文的价值是诊断工具；对做预训练的人，更有价值的是它指出了 loss 之外的分布形状指标。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why sampling more often fails to produce genuinely valid diversity. It moves the analysis from final-output diversity metrics to the model’s stepwise next-token distribution. The main claim is that diversity collapse comes from two calibration failures: valid tokens are not consistently ranked above invalid ones, and probability mass among valid continuations is too concentrated on a small head while invalid options occupy a heavy tail.
summary_en.importance: The useful point for pretraining research is that diversity is framed as a property of the learned distribution, not merely a decoding issue. Temperature scaling, top-k, top-p, and min-p can only reshape or truncate the distribution the model already provides. They cannot reliably recover valid alternatives if those alternatives are interleaved with invalid tokens or assigned very low mass. This suggests that pretraining and post-training should be evaluated not only by loss and task accuracy, but also by how probability mass is allocated across multiple valid continuations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces a validity-diversity framework. Validity is the total probability mass assigned to the set of valid responses. Diversity is the normalized effective support size of the model distribution after conditioning on validity, using entropy to measure how broadly the model covers valid outputs. This setup assumes that valid responses are equally preferred, which makes it well suited to controlled tasks with known valid sets. The authors then define two token-level bottlenecks. Order calibration captures whether valid tokens appear before invalid tokens in the ranked distribution. When valid and invalid tokens are interleaved, any rank-based cutoff faces a direct trade-off. Shape calibration captures whether probability mass is spread across valid continuations or concentrated on a few head options. Raising temperature can reduce head concentration, but much of the released mass may flow into the invalid tail. The paper also analyzes how these local errors compound over sequence length.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study covers 14 language models across multiple families and scales. The authors use controlled settings with exactly known valid sets and oracle cutoff baselines, which helps separate decoding failures from failures of the model distribution itself. The results show that common top-token filtering methods cannot reliably achieve both high validity and high diversity. Tight cutoffs preserve validity but discard valid alternatives; loose cutoffs recover some alternatives but admit invalid tokens. Temperature sampling has a related failure mode: increasing temperature does not selectively recover rare valid continuations, because probability mass also moves into the invalid tail. The paper also gives qualitative examples of output concentration, such as 59% of GPT-4-generated stories beginning with “Once upon a time.”
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction and formal setup first, especially the definitions of validity, diversity, order calibration, and shape calibration. Then read the diagnostic experiments with known valid sets and oracle cutoffs. The most useful figures are likely the ones showing ranked token distributions, validity-diversity trade-offs, and error compounding over sequence length. Estimated reading time is 25 to 35 minutes. The deeper pretraining question is whether these calibration failures can be reduced by data mixture design, multi-answer supervision, entropy-aware objectives, or post-training procedures that avoid over-compressing the output distribution.

recommendation.zh: 不改训练目标，但把 diversity collapse 拆成 order/shape calibration；只看框架和诊断实验，能指导内部校准评测。
recommendation.en: No new training objective, but the order/shape calibration split is a useful diagnostic; read the framework and experiments for calibration probes.

paper.title: Focus on the Core: Empowering Diffusion Large Language Models by Self-Contrast
paper.abstract: The iterative denoising paradigm of Diffusion Large Language Models (DLMs) endows them with a distinct advantage in global context modeling. However, current decoding strategies fail to leverage this capability, typically exhibiting a local preference that overlooks the heterogeneous information density within the context, ultimately degrading generation quality. To address this limitation, we systematically investigate high-information-density (HD) tokens and present two key findings: (1) expli

summary.core_problem: 扩散式语言模型（DLM）在迭代去噪中具备“全局建模”的潜力，但现有解码（尤其是带 CFG 的逐步填充/置信度驱动策略）呈现明显的局部偏置：更靠近已确定位置的 token 更容易被优先确定，导致模型忽视上下文中信息密度不均的事实——少量“高信息密度（HD）token”往往是推理与语义的锚点。论文要解决的是：在不改训练的前提下，如何在解码阶段识别并利用这些 HD token，提升 DLM 的生成质量，并进一步利用其“更早收敛”的动态特性加速解码。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身（目标函数/数据/优化）影响有限，但对“扩散 LM 的推断-训练接口”有直接启发：1）把 DLM 的错误更多归因于解码策略与去噪动态不匹配，而非模型容量不足；2）提出一种可操作的“信息密度视角”来解释 DLM 去噪过程中哪些 token 在起决定作用；3）给出训练无关（training-free）的改进路径，适合作为后续做法的基线：要么把这种 HD token 的偏置显式纳入训练目标（例如在训练时强化对 HD token 的一致性/稳定性），要么在推断时做更结构化的 token 调度。
summary.technical_approach:
核心思路是“自对比（self-contrast）地强迫模型围绕 HD token 去收敛”。论文先给出两条经验事实：
1）显式条件化 HD token 会提升质量：用 CFG 构造条件/无条件轨迹的对比，若优先保留/强调 HD token（Mask HD）比优先保留 LD token（Mask LD）更好。
2）HD token 有早收敛倾向：在迭代去噪中，HD token 更早稳定到最终取值。
在此基础上提出 FoCore：在去噪轨迹中动态识别“已收敛的 HD token”，将其暂时重新 mask，构造一个对比的负样本条件；然后对比原条件与“mask 掉 HD token”的条件下的 logits，用差分信号引导后续去噪，使模型在后续步骤更依赖这些核心 token（直观上是：如果把核心锚点拿掉，模型分布会变差；用这个差异作为引导，强化锚点的约束力）。
进一步提出 FoCore_A：利用 HD token 早收敛，一旦检测到其稳定，就在局部窗口内对稳定候选做并行解码，从而减少总去噪步数/墙钟时间。整体属于 decoding policy 的改造，不改参数、不加训练。
summary.experiments:
文中给出的关键数字主要集中在两类：
- 质量：在数学子域上，Mask HD 相对 Mask LD 的 Acc@1 稳定提升，示例包括 Prealgebra +2.07%（0.579→0.599）、Counting & Probability +1.48%，Algebra +0.76%，Precalculus +0.55%。这些结果用于支撑“HD token 确实是信息骨架”。
- 效率：FoCore_A 报告将单样本延迟从 20.76s 降到 8.64s（-58.4%），并带来 2.07× 的 decoding step reduction（相对标准 CFG）。
此外论文声称在 LLaDA 与 Dream 两类 backbone 上都能稳定提升，但在给定全文片段中未看到更完整的基准表格与方差/显著性信息；若全文包含更多任务（非数学）与不同长度设置，建议重点核对其泛化范围与失败案例。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看引言里 Figure 1 的两个部分：1(a) 用具体推理例子解释 HD token 如何“定分支”；1(b) 的 Mask HD vs Mask LD 是整篇的因果动机。
- 重点找“HD token 的定义/识别准则”和“收敛检测”的实现细节：HD 是基于梯度/置信度/互信息/CFG 差分，还是基于启发式分数？收敛判据是 token-level argmax 稳定、还是分布熵阈值？这些决定方法可复现性与可迁移性。
- 读 FoCore 的算法段落时，抓住它到底在做哪一种 guidance：logit 差分如何注入（加权、温度、步长随 t 的 schedule），以及与标准 CFG 的关系（叠加/替换）。
- 读 FoCore_A 时，关注“并行解码窗口”的选择与错误传播：窗口太大可能引入不一致，太小收益有限；看是否有消融说明速度-质量折中。

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion LMs can, in principle, leverage global context via iterative denoising, but common decoding policies (notably CFG-style iterative filling) exhibit a strong locality bias: tokens near already-denoised positions get over-prioritized. This clashes with the heterogeneous information density of natural language, where a small set of high-information-density (HD) tokens often act as reasoning/semantic anchors. The paper targets a training-free way to (i) exploit HD tokens to improve generation quality and (ii) use their early-convergence behavior to speed up decoding.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to foundation-model research in two ways: (1) it attributes a meaningful portion of DLM quality loss to inference-time policy mismatch rather than model capacity, which matters when comparing AR vs diffusion paradigms; (2) it introduces an “information-density” lens that could be turned into training objectives (e.g., explicitly stabilizing anchor tokens earlier, or supervising denoising order); (3) it provides a practical, training-free baseline for diffusion-LM decoding improvements, useful before committing to costly retraining.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is built around self-contrast over HD tokens. The paper motivates two empirical observations: (a) explicitly conditioning on HD tokens improves accuracy (Mask HD beats Mask LD), and (b) HD tokens tend to converge earlier during denoising. 
FoCore then dynamically identifies converged HD tokens along the denoising trajectory, temporarily re-masks them to create a contrastive negative condition, and uses the logit difference between the original condition and the “HD-masked” condition as a guidance signal. Intuitively, if removing anchor tokens degrades the model’s distribution, the contrastive gap can be used to force subsequent denoising steps to stay anchored on those tokens.
FoCore_A is an acceleration variant: once HD tokens are detected as stable, it performs parallel decoding over stable candidates within a local context window, reducing the number of sequential denoising steps and wall-clock latency.
summary_en.experiments:
Key reported results in the provided content:
- Quality evidence via Mask HD vs Mask LD on math subdomains (Acc@1): Prealgebra +2.07% (0.579→0.599), Counting & Probability +1.48%, Algebra +0.76%, Precalculus +0.55%.
- Efficiency: FoCore_A reduces per-sample latency from 20.76s to 8.64s (-58.4%) and achieves a 2.07× reduction in decoding steps compared to standard CFG.
The paper claims consistent gains across LLaDA and Dream backbones; when reading the full paper, it is worth checking breadth beyond math, variance across seeds, and any quality regressions under longer contexts or different noise schedules.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Start with Figure 1: the qualitative “anchor token” example and the quantitative Mask HD vs Mask LD comparison are the causal motivation.
- Focus on how HD tokens are operationally defined and detected, and how “convergence” is measured (argmax stability vs entropy thresholds, etc.). These details determine reproducibility and transfer.
- In the FoCore algorithm section, track precisely how the contrastive logits are combined with CFG (additive vs replacement, weights/schedules over timesteps).
- For FoCore_A, look for ablations on the parallel window size and failure modes (inconsistency/error propagation), which govern the speed–quality trade-off.

recommendation.zh: 做 diffusion LM 的值得看：它把“哪些 token 先收敛、该不该被特殊利用”说成了可操作的 decoding prior；先看 HD token 分析和 FoCore 机制，效果数字先保留。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you work on diffusion LMs: it turns “which tokens converge early and should be privileged” into an actionable decoding prior; read the HD-token analysis and FoCore mechanism first, and treat the gains as provisional.

institutions: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences
